# Original Augmentor website mark

Selected from [augmentoragent.com 68a59fd](https://github.com/ManoloRemiddi/augmentoragent.com/tree/68a59fd7c485a12d5d7befc448b5692343901f64).
The original CSS, companion favicon and MIT licence are verbatim. SOURCE.json
records public paths and SHA-256. The live website CSS/icon match these bytes.
The local JSX/CSS binding uses DSH's existing brand slot, preserves the 7/9/4-second
shape/flow/breath animations. Authored overrides fit the original slot, use black
outline/smoke in Light, preserve the Dark palette, and release brand-row clipping
without changing layout, labels or actions.
No remote asset or JavaScript animation loop is loaded. Supplier DSH/dashboard
source and notices remain separate. See [qualification](../../../../docs/HARNESS-BRAND.md).
